title: Against the market replaces Other upsets in Last week
items: Last week now shows the model's record on the games where it and the market picked different teams, for example 2–3 on 5 disagreements in football and 5–10 on 15 in basketball. Agreeing with the market proves little; these are the games that test the model.
Under it, the biggest split of the week: the model's and the market's chance and how it ended.
A week with no priced disagreement falls back to the other upsets, as before.
